source_complete_proposition: A microscope stands on a laboratory bench beside a rack of labeled glass slides and a separate specimen container.
literal_final_phrase: On the right side of the same laboratory bench, a compact microscope stands beside a rack of glass slides with small paper end labels; the sealed specimen ampoule is a separate container in front of them.

pass_requires: Recognizable microscope supported on laboratory bench
A separate rack visibly holding glass slides, with end labels distinguishable as labels
Microscope and slide rack visibly beside one another
The foreground specimen ampoule remains a separate container from microscope and slides
All owners and relations are readable together in this saved image
supplemental_gate.claim_limits: This visual context cannot prove biopsy, histopathology, human origin of tissue, diagnosis or viable biological material.

result.evidence: Microscope eyepieces, objectives and stage are identifiable at the right, and a separate plastic rack holds upright glass slides with distinct paper end labels. The central amber vial remains a separate container on the same visible bench. However the microscope base/foot and its bench support are cropped or occluded behind the slide rack at the right image edge. The complete source proposition includes microscope-on-bench support, so this endpoint is not fully observable and the whole retained-source gate cannot pass.
visible_components: labeled glass slides held by a rack
unobservable_or_partial_components: microscope foot/base support on the bench
result.claim_boundary: Visible purple slide patches do not retrospectively select the declined D13 coverslip/tissue-section source or prove histopathology.
